premium_consent_text.message:
🎯 How to get Premium:
1️⃣ Make a donation of any amount greater than the selected plan (Example: 1010 RUB = access for a year, 1991 = lifetime access)
2️⃣ In the 'Private comment' field MANDATORY specify your email

👉 After payment, a secret activation key will be sent to the specified email
👉 Enter it on this page and enjoy the full capabilities of Yandex Music Downloader v3!

❓ Frequently asked questions:
What if I lost the key \ didn't receive a notification by email \ can't pay?
→ 📧 Write to us in support (dreambuilder.first@gmail.com) - we will find a way out of the situation individually!

What if the application stops working after some time, and I have already paid?
→ ⚠️ Considering that we are an unofficial Yandex application and depend on their API, problems periodically arise that we try to solve INSTANTLY.
→ Nevertheless, the risk of breakdowns, of course, exists, therefore, when making a donation, confirm that you are doing it voluntarily and not with your last money (otherwise, use MP3 downloading completely free of charge).
